Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This
document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on a 
weekly or 
monthly bases as indicated by W1/M1 in the above title block.
The 
first draft initiated at 
Portable Eslah 
220kv
substation, Upper Egypt zone, ECET.
Safety Precautions
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,
A work permit must be issued,
The qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution 
marks surrounding the work area,
Appropriate personal protective tools must be used, safety 
 shoes, helmet breathing mask, safety glasses
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet, gloves, and shoes,
Complete set of tools
Work to be Carried Out
Check the air gas pressure gauge, approx..5kg/cm2
Check the air pressure gauge.
Check the position indicator.
Check the operating counter.
Inspect the circuit breaker visually.
